items.title: Hollywood Has Flipped on GenAI, Says 'Avatar' VFX House Weta FX Chief: 'If You Don't Have an AI Strategy, Don't Bother'
items.excerpt: Weta FX CEO Daniel Seah told Taiwan Creative Content Fest that studio legal departments banned generative AI early last year, but by Q3 clients were demanding an AI strategy, mostly to find cost savings.

items.title: AI Takes Center Stage at Tech-Forward AFM With Innovation Hub and AFM House Expansion
items.excerpt: The American Film Market puts AI at the center of this year's edition, with an expanded AFM House and Innovation Hub programming built around AI production tools.

items.title: How Grimes' Cameo in Theater-Bound AI Film 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' Came Together (EXCLUSIVE)
items.excerpt: Grimes will have a minutes-long cameo in 'Gods Don't Give Gifts,' billed as the first AI-generated feature set to debut in theaters. (Deadline covered the film's AFM sales 10-26; the cameo is the new fact.)

items.title: David Ellison Is Very Bullish On AI's Creative Potential
items.excerpt: On his first earnings call running both Paramount and Warner Bros., Skydance CEO David Ellison called AI 'the biggest creative unlock in modern history' while dismissing 'AI slop' - a studio AI-production policy signal.

items.title: Cinematographers' Favorite Festival Is All About AI This Year - but Artists Still Hate the Tech
items.excerpt: Camerimage in Torun opened with AI-generated videos and remarks from a robot, while cinematographers on the ground remained hostile to generative tools. (Camerimage opening carded earlier - only use if a concrete new fact.)

items.title: Argentina's 'Listen to MEH' Wins $500K Higgsfield AI Film Prize
items.excerpt: The first fiction short from Argentine AI production company PURGA Studio took Higgsfield's $500K top prize, awarded by a jury including Ed Catmull, Phedon Papamichael, Paul W.S. Anderson and Alex Proyas.

items.title: 'Backrooms' Director Kane Parsons Says He's 'Anti-AI': No Artist Needs 'Generative Tools'
items.excerpt: Kane Parsons, the YouTube-born director of A24's 'Backrooms,' says no artist needs generative tools and lays out his stance on AI in the creative process.

items.title: Alex Proyas Takes Over Directing Duties On Antonio Banderas Historical Epic 'Cortés'
items.excerpt: Alex Proyas replaces Paul Mignot on 'Cortés,' an AI-enabled epic starring Antonio Banderas, written by Nicholas Kazan and co-financed by Utopai Studios and Ex Machina Studios, combining live action with AI-generated environments.

items.title: AI Dubbing Pioneer Flawless Sells Tech To Steven Schuurman Venture
items.excerpt: Flawless, the British company that spent $100M building SAG-AFTRA-endorsed visual-dubbing tech (TrueSync, used on 'Fall'), went into administration and sold its IP to a venture of Elastic founder Steven Schuurman.

items.title: CAA's Bryan Lourd Discusses AI As Agency Weighs In On NYT Vs. OpenAI Battle
items.excerpt: CAA, with major stars on board, weighed in on the New York Times v. OpenAI training-data case, and Bryan Lourd laid out the agency's position on what AI may train on and what it should pay for.

items.title: NFTS, Falmouth University awarded £650,000 from BFI to support industry use of AI, virtual production
items.excerpt: The BFI Innovation Challenge Fund puts £650K into two programmes, including Falmouth's 'Lab to slate' giving eight UK indie creatives training, tools, legal guidance and ethics frameworks for applying AI in real screen projects.

items.title: ArtStation Adds AI Declarations & Default AI Filtering for Artwork
items.excerpt: ArtStation, the portfolio hub for film/game concept and VFX artists, now lets artists label how much generative AI went into a project, report unlabeled work, and filters AI content by default.

items.title: Introducing SwitchX 3.0
items.excerpt: Beeble's production video-to-video compositing model SwitchX 3.0 adds up to four references, moving/dynamic backgrounds, tighter camera tracking and prompt control, rebuilt on MiniMax H3 with Beeble's own dataset. (Off-list vendor source: no allowed outlet had covered it yet; neural relighting keyword.)

items.title: When Video Becomes an Interface | inside view
items.excerpt: Inside Runway Labs, designers prototype what real-time video models make possible: select anything on screen to dive deeper with no prompt, resizable videos the model reinterprets, and a drawing app that animates sketches in your own style.

items.title: 라이언이 AI 애니로…카카오·오픈AI '그래도, 라이언' 공개
items.excerpt: 카카오가 오픈AI와 기술 협업으로 라이언의 첫 AI 단편 애니메이션 '그래도, 라이언'(약 5분)을 공개했다. 기획·연출 등 사람의 창작 과정에 생성형 AI를 접목했고, 감정선과 맞지 않는 결과물은 반복 재작업했다.

items.title: 최휘영 "AI 파도, 연대의 방식으로 항로 찾는 영화인에 박수"
items.excerpt: 최휘영 문체부 장관이 '2026 대한민국예술원 영화전'에서 AI 단편 '확인'을 관람했다. 영화전 주제는 '임권택 없이 임권택 영화 만들기' — 임권택 감독의 연출 문법을 AI가 학습해 새 영상을 만든 실험이다.
